connector.name: MCP Abap Abap Adt Api
connector.registryDescription: MCP server wrapping abap-adt-api for ABAP ADT development workflows against SAP systems
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-abap-abap-adt-api. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mario-andreschak account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
